title: EP 34 — CLAUDE AS JSON
lines: claude -p prints text. Scripts want data.
Claude dash p prints text. But a script wants structured data, not prose.
Add dash dash output dash format json, and you get a structured envelope instead.
The text answer lands in the dot result field.
Pipe it to j q dash r dot result, to pull out just the answer.
The same payload carries the session I D and total cost in U S D, per call.
